title: Events, Retreats and Gatherings | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: A barn on 22 acres in Bridgton, Maine, for showers, reunions, retreats, teas, small concerts, workshops and classes. Up to 135 guests. Tables and chairs included.
heading: Pull up a chair. *There's plenty to catch up on.*
lede: Gather the family around the barn tables for a reunion or shower. Step onto the patio between conversations. We host events for up to 135 guests, Sunday through Friday, May through October. Tables and chairs are included. Our events are alcohol free.
hero_alt: The barn with round tables set on the patio, lawn in front

kinds.title: Baby and wedding showers
kinds.body: Set the round tables for the people closest to you. We welcome baby and wedding showers in the barn, with a patio outside.

kinds.title: Reunions and birthdays
kinds.body: Share a meal with relatives you don't see often enough. We have room for gatherings of up to 135 guests and a prep kitchen for your caterer.

kinds.title: Retreats and company gatherings
kinds.body: Meet in the barn, then take a break on the patio. We welcome women's retreats and company gatherings.

kinds.title: Small concerts
kinds.body: Hear music beneath the old beams. The High Street Jazz Band played at our open house. Contact Susan about hosting a small concert inside the barn.

kinds.title: Teas and workshops
kinds.body: Bring friends around the tables for tea or a creative workshop. Tell Susan about the gathering you'd like to host.

kinds.title: Community events
kinds.body: We want this farm to serve our neighbors, too. We've pledged to donate use of the venue for one charitable event each year. Contact Susan about what you have in mind.

classes.heading: An afternoon of cardmaking
classes.body: Sit down with friends to make something by hand. We've hosted papercrafting and fall cardmaking in the barn. Check our Facebook page for upcoming classes and sign up details.
classes.alt: Guests beside the stone planter at the barn on a fall afternoon

upcoming_empty: Check our Facebook page for event announcements, or contact Susan about hosting your own gathering.

retreats.heading: A place for parents to connect
retreats.body: We hope to give parents of children with disabilities a place to connect. Susan worked in special education and has a daughter with autism. We envision gatherings with a guest speaker and time for parents to talk. [CONFIRM: ready to announce]

closing.heading: Let's make room for your gathering.
closing.body: Tell Susan what you're planning and how many people you'd like to invite. A month or season is enough to start discussing dates and pricing.
